ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 22.1% (9,755/44,076); held flat. FY2023 18.2%, FY2024 17.8%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Spanish statutory corporate rate 25%; Damodaran Europe Power effective tax 22.3% as a cross-check.

da_pct_revenue.source: PLACEHOLDER, NOT FILED DATA: D&A is not reported in the tool data (not found). 12% is an unsupported stand-in, below capex of ~17% for a growing utility. Reviewer must replace it with the figure from the Iberdrola cash flow statement.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 capex/revenue was 14.9%, 17.8% and 17.3% (average ~16.7%); held at ~17% for the grid and renewables build-out.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 3.266% (ECB 10Y AAA, 2026-11-05) + relevered beta 0.66 x Spain ERP 5.78% (Damodaran) = Ke ~7.1%. Beta is the Damodaran Europe Power cash-corrected unlevered 0.453 relevered at D/E 0.60 and 25% tax. Pre-tax Kd 5.18% (Damodaran), ~3.9% after tax. Weights 62/38 give ~5.9%, rounded to 6.0%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation/nominal growth, below the 3.27% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: NOT FOUND, 0 is a placeholder only: borrowings are null in the ESEF extraction, so net debt cannot be computed. Cash was 3,670,000,000 EUR (5QK37QC7NWOJ8D7WVQ45-2025-12-31-ESEF-ES-0). Reviewer must enter total debt less cash.

diluted_shares.source: NOT FOUND, 0 is a placeholder only: diluted weighted shares are null in the ESEF extraction. Reviewer must enter them in units.
